name: roaddraft-eval-knowledge
description: Reference standards behind the RoadDraft drafting spec, task generator and verifier. Each source PDF lives under <collection>/raw/ (gitignored; sha256 pinned here) and is mirrored by committed artifacts: reading-order text with one separator line per PDF page, a per-page index, and the PDF outline.
citation: Cite manual text as '<id> p. <ppm_page> (pdf <pdf_page>)', e.g. 'ppm-text p. 2-8 (pdf 21)', and an example sheet as '<id> pdf <pdf_page> "<title>"', e.g. 'ppm-examples pdf 45 "65 LAYOUT-1"'. Both are the fields of the separator lines in the .txt artifacts.

sources.publisher: California Department of Transportation, Division of Design, Office of CADD & Engineering GIS Support
sources.edition: Compiled PDF titled 'Plans Preparation Manual, last updated April 14, 2023' (foreword dated May 2026, file modified 2026-05-27); every section carries its own revision date, 2008 to 2022
sources.license: Copyright California Department of Transportation, all rights reserved. Held for reference and spec review; not for redistribution with the public benchmark.
sources.notes: Chapter 1 general drawing criteria. Chapter 2 is the project-plans standard: 2-1.2 drafting standards, 2-1.3 dimensions/bearings/scales/stationing, 2-1.5 plan border sheets, 2-1.6 signatures, 2-1.7 project ID block, 2-1.8 sheet ID codes, 2-2.2 title sheets, 2-2.5 layouts/profiles/superelevation with checklists, 2-2.6 onward per sheet type. Chapter 3 preliminary drawings. Chapter 4 right-of-way mapping.
